originality.rationale: Primary scholarly literature, mathematical-record searches and previously documented related mathematical claims were checked by implication, not titles. Exact central-binomial successor jump marginal and simple-root valuation distributions substantially overlap the elementary drift calculation; these are expressly excluded as separate novelty. The surviving claim is exclusively the Catalan-current-valuation versus successor-drift covariance, including the special 3-adic formula and sharp limiting constants. Both elementary linear-root drift marginals can be recovered from pre-existing generic information and are not claimed as independent contributions; the covariance needs a conditional carry computation. Priority remains historically qualified.
residual_risks: General digital-transfer theory might subsume the covariance as an unrecorded corollary, despite no explicit matching statement located.
The two linear-root drift marginals are already covered; they are auxiliary calculations only, not part of the originality claim.

value.rationale: The next-step p-adic divisibility drift of the classical Catalan sequence is an intrinsically motivated local statistic, and its covariance with the current valuation measures arithmetic regression rather than a single-index frequency. A sharp all-odd-prime, all-prime-power-depth negative-regression law, explicit prime-three exception in the regression formula, exact prime-dependent covariance limits and sole vanishing block form a natural complete classification. The cross-statistic requires nontrivial carry-state conditioning and is not a renamed marginal histogram; no unrelated downstream claim is needed.
